root_cause: The original source-led blog generator converted the official CPNL 6 October 2026 closing date into a forecast opening date in both 29 and 30 October 2026 drafts. The canonical Edge exporter independently refused these GENERATED drafts because approved_at was NULL, while GitHub renderer surfaced the legitimate HTTP 403 as repeated runtime failures rather than a pending editorial approval state.
fix: In the EXISTING original blog queue and service-only approved exporter, reject known official-date inversion before any public release; original GitHub renderer classifies exact authenticated exporter 403 BLOG_PUBLIC_EXPORT_NOT_APPROVED as a safe NO_ACTION, while every other auth failure remains fatal; no cron or approval change.
prevention_rule: Every money/finance/subsidy date claim needs current primary-source verified effective dates at publication reference date. Original publisher cannot infer editorial approval from content_ready; correct or discard outdated content, then require actual approval and exact protected release/main/Netlify/browser readback. Do not invent guaranteed first-run success.
